{"id":1849555965,"question_id":4119,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765133981,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1849555965/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Distance Between Three Equal Elements II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumDistance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<int  , vector<int>>mp;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            mp[nums[i]].push_back(i);\n        }\n\n        int sum = 0;\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            vector<int> indexes = it.second;\n            sort(indexes.begin() , indexes.end());\n            if(indexes.size() >= 3)\n            {\n                sum += abs(indexes[2] - indexes[0]);\n                for(int i=1 ; i<3 ; i++)\n                {\n                    sum += abs(indexes[i] - indexes[i-1]);\n                }\n                ans = min(ans , sum);\n            }\n           \n        }\n        return ans == INT_MAX ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-distance-between-three-equal-elements-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1268}
